newsitem.title: UK: Dixons says to buy Harry Moore assets.
newsitem.headline: Dixons says to buy Harry Moore assets.

text.p: Consumer electrical group Dixons Group Plc said on Monday that it has agreed to purchase the retail assets of Harry Moore Ltd, an electrical retailing company based in Ireland.
The group did not mention the consideration it would pay for the aquisition.
Dixons said the Harry Moore retail chain includes six stores based in or around Dublin and has an annual turnover of 10 million stg.
"The acquisition of the Harry Moore Ltd retail outlets will enable us to accelerate our development programme in the Irish Republic," said John Clare, Dixons' chief executive.
Dixons Group has already expressed plans to open its Dixons, Currys and PC World stores in Ireland.
